shortDescription: TORONTO, Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Cronos Group Inc. NASDAQ:CRON TSX:CRON (“Cronos”), an innovative global cannabis company, announced today that for the third consecutive year it is bringing back its popular limited-edition Caramel Green Apple flavor to its best-selling lineup of SOURZ by…

children: (“Cronos”), an innovative global cannabis company, announced today that for the third consecutive year it is bringing back its popular limited-edition Caramel Green Apple flavor to its best-selling lineup of SOURZ by Spinach® edibles. For the first time, this seasonal flavor will launch exclusively in the SOURZ by Spinach® Fully Blasted 10-pack, the #1 edible multipack in Canada1.

The brand is also welcoming back the popular Spinach® Sweet Green Apple 1g vape that first launched in 2025. This limited-edition flavor bolsters a best-selling lineup of 1g vapes with unique cannabinoid ratios and flavor combinations that have resonated with adult consumers and made Spinach® the #1 brand nationally in the vape category1.
The limited-time green-apple flavored additions to the lineups of SOURZ by Spinach® Fully Blasted multipacks and Spinach® vapes include:
SOURZ by Spinach® Caramel Green Apple Fully Blasted 10mg gummies, now exclusively available in the 10x10 multipack
Spinach® Sweet Green Apple 1g vape (Sativa): Infused with liquid diamonds and featuring sweet, yet crisp green apple flavor notes

“We’re thrilled to bring back our fan-favorite green apple products for yet another year to celebrate the season with familiar and popular fall-themed flavors,” said Jeff Jacobson, Chief Growth Officer, Cronos. “We believe that our long-term leadership position in the edibles and vapes categories is because of our focus on listening to our consumers and what they want to see in their cannabis products. We’re proud that consumers have kept this seasonal flavor in mind and welcome its return every year, and we’re excited to reintroduce it in the multipack format that has resonated so strongly with adult consumers.”
The seasonal SOURZ by Spinach® Fully Blasted gummies multipack and Spinach® 1g vape products are available now across Canada. To view the full lineup of Spinach® products, visit spinachcannabis.com.
¹ HiFyre Retail Analytics – National Retail Dollar Sales by Brand in Canada – August 2026.

Cronos is a global cannabis company focused on scaling leading consumer goods products through research and development and innovation. With a passion to responsibly elevate the consumer experience, Cronos is building an iconic brand portfolio. Cronos’ diverse international brand portfolio includes Spinach
. For more information about Cronos and its brands, please visit: thecronosgroup.com.
